notes: The telemetry overlay is twice as fast. It was running at 11 frames a second against its own 30 Hz loop, and the cause was one detail: handing the trace picture to the window costs 870 ms with a transparency channel and 2.8 ms without one - the same picture, 300 times the cost. Now 22 fps, and the trace edges are cleaner than before. Also: PRO GOAT drew a flat speed line for a lap with no position data (an ACC MoTeC export or an AC .tc ghost) because it was still framed on the PREVIOUS circuit's corner - it now frames on its own. And a reference lap with mostly-missing position data could report the circuit as 12.9 metres long; that is treated as unknown.
